worldcombat.skill.feint.summary: A decoy that knocks down whatever guard the target has raised, and only then does the real jab land; the more guard layers torn away, the heavier the hit. Against a target with no guard it is still a very fast jab.
worldcombat.skill.feint.use.0: Strip a raised guard to open the target for a heavy follow-up
worldcombat.skill.feint.use.1: Use its very short wind-up to peel a guard away before it can soak a heavier blow
worldcombat.skill.feint.use.2: Land a very fast jab on a target with no guard
worldcombat.skill.feint.description.0: The jab deals about %1$s damage; each extra guard layer torn away adds another %2$s times its power; a target with no guard still takes this jab.
worldcombat.skill.feint.description.1: Tears up to %1$s guard layers off the target (Protect, Detect, Wide Guard and Harden all belong to the same guard family) and lunges up to %2$s blocks forward.
worldcombat.skill.feint.description.2: Hit radius %1$s blocks; a hit shoves the target up to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.feint.commit.on: Commit: drops the decoy and truly strikes, raising jab and exposure, tearing one more guard layer and lunging further; the cost is a longer wind-up, recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.feint.commit.off: Feint: extremely fast with a short cooldown; tearing the guard away is the whole point and the jab is light.
worldcombat.skill.feint.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and goes on cooldown for %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.feint.growth.0: From level %1$s the jab rises to %2$s power and tears %3$s guard layers at once.
worldcombat.skill.feint.growth.1: From level %1$s the jab rises again to %2$s power and the lunge grows to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.feint.preference.commi: On: drop the decoy and strike for real, jab x1.35, +0.1 exposure per layer, one more guard layer torn and lunge x1.1, at the cost of +3 ticks wind-up, +2 ticks recovery and +10 ticks cooldown. Off (feint): extremely fast with a short cooldown; tearing the guard away is the whole point and the jab is light.
worldcombat.skill.feint.preference.ai.ma: The companion only lunges toward a target within this distance; larger values let it commit from further out, and make it easier to be shaken off mid-lunge.
worldcombat.skill.feint.preference.ai.br: On: a target carrying a guard ranks much higher, so the companion strips it before the shared order. Off: ordinary fast-attack ordering.
